scope: Assessment of whether the native four-level rho benchmark supplies or measures an ECDLP transfer across the conductor lattice.

lattice_relations.kind: ascending separable cyclic-kernel isogeny certificate for each of 32 selected pairs

benchmark_relation.kind: native comparison sharing only the known integer scalar and numeric random streams

obligations.evidence: deep_selection.json binds 32 discovery certificates for raw parent_b to raw bottom_b degree-271 edges.
The certificate supports the ascending B-to-P edge, but no explicit normalized point-map formula or executable evaluator is serialized in the discovery or rho artifacts.
The reverse P-to-B direction is descending and requires a dual/evaluator that was not constructed.
Requires evaluator formulas, normalization, kernel and exceptional-point checks.
The benchmark constructs the order-r subgroup independently on every endpoint and never transports a subgroup point.
All planted targets are native Q=kP targets; no transported DLP was solved.
No transfer stage was invoked or assigned zero cost.
The sealed run contains 20,480 correct native solves and reports calibrated walk_ops summaries for all four levels.
The benchmark is a noncausal endpoint association and its predeclared A/A inference gate failed.
Walk counts exclude map construction/evaluation, transported setup, recovery, and a frozen primitive conversion.

cost_accounting.qualification: Reusable discovery cost was not converted to per-target work.

cost_accounting.measurement: 3556 invocations; 492.804730039 total seconds summed across workers
cost_accounting.qualification: Wall time is descriptive and has no frozen conversion to walk_ops.

cost_accounting.phase: isogeny construction, evaluation, dual, and transported recovery
cost_accounting.qualification: Absent stages remain open costs, not zero-cost stages.

controls: All four arms share target scalar and numeric walk streams within a block, but execute natively.
Only B-P is exactly calibrated-weight paired; the other contrasts are balanced common-random-number comparisons.
The 8192 held-out A/A solves compare two independent walk namespaces with fixed target and setup roots.
No transported-data or coordinate-isomorphism control ran because no executable map was supplied.

exploration_boundary.measured_metric: online walk_ops after target-dependent table construction

narrowest_supported_finding: The sealed experiment measured endpoint-native walk-work associations at four conductor orders. It did not construct, validate, execute, or price an isogeny transfer.
next_obligation: Serialize and independently validate a normalized ascending B-to-P evaluator and its descending P-to-B dual for a selected certified edge, prove or test order-r subgroup preservation including exceptional points, then run a preregistered native-versus-transported paired trial with construction, evaluation, recovery, verification, memory, cold-start, and amortized costs separated.
